nodes.description: The primary lesion is in the RPE. In the oldest examined eye, RPE was lost except for an island in the macula; RPE cells left Bruch's membrane, migrated into the neuroretina around blood vessels, possibly by epithelial-mesenchymal transition, and the choriocapillaris thinned. Bestrophin-1 itself was barely detectable even in surviving RPE. The disease begins in the periphery, where it forms the characteristic circumferential band.
